scenarios.name: Bad Publish — wrong hook posted
scenarios.trigger: autonomous_publisher_live posts hook with wrong pricing or banned word
scenarios.expected_response: rollback_guard detects anomaly → freeze autonomy → notify via Discord
scenarios.notes: System would catch via content filter before going live in LIMITED/LIVE mode

scenarios.name: Stale Feed Read — outdated GA4 used for decision
scenarios.trigger: GA4 data >7 days stale. System makes recommendations based on old numbers.
scenarios.expected_response: rollback_guard flags stale data → killswitch on GA4-dependent agents
scenarios.notes: trust_optimizer would also flag this as trust drag

scenarios.name: Failed Budget Shift — API call fails silently
scenarios.trigger: auto_budget_shifter attempts R100 shift but Meta API returns 500 error
scenarios.expected_response: Action marked failed → logged to budget-actions.json → trust score unaffected (fail<3)
scenarios.notes: Small failure threshold protects trust score. 3+ failures = anomaly trigger.

scenarios.name: Anomaly Spike — multiple failures in short window
scenarios.trigger: 3 or more agent runs fail within 1 hour
scenarios.expected_response: rollback_guard triggers freeze → all publishers disabled → manual review required
scenarios.notes: Correct — this is the safety net working as designed

scenarios.name: Lead Routing Error — hot lead routed to cold nurture
scenarios.trigger: lead_router_live mis-scores a lead (score=82 routed to nurture instead of WhatsApp)
scenarios.expected_response: leads routed incorrectly → flagged in next review → rollback log updated
scenarios.actual_rollback: No automatic rollback — routing is non-reversible. Manual correction required.
scenarios.notes: Routing is non-reversible by design. Soft rule: manual review of hot leads before WhatsApp send

scenarios.name: Trust Score Drop — mode downgrade cascade
scenarios.trigger: Trust drops from 8.2 to 6.5 due to 5 failures
scenarios.expected_response: 8>7: LIMITED→MINIMAL. 7>6: MINIMAL→OFF. All autonomy disabled immediately.
scenarios.actual_rollback: Mode downgrade is automatic via live_mode_controller threshold check
scenarios.notes: Correct — trust-gated system handles this automatically
